fusions.name: Long Chop
fusions.desc: Brings the blade on the end of the haft down on a target up to 4 tiles away for 4 slashing damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: A wide hooking cleave that deals 12 slashing damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 6 seconds, and your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Choked Grip
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Point, Then Edge
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
